project_name: Déco Touché - Montreal Renovation & Handyman Admin SaaS
theme_strategy: Dark mode default with high contrast, tactile textures, rich navy/obsidian background, artisan gold/terracotta accents, and crisp typography for job site mobility.

layout_and_navigation.desktop: Sidebar fixed 256px wide, crisp glass border `border-r border-border`, background `bg-card/95 backdrop-blur-xl`. Main content `ml-64 p-6 md:p-8 min-h-screen pb-24 md:pb-8`.
layout_and_navigation.mobile: Sticky top bar with Montreal brand badge, notification bell, quick search button, dark toggle, and mobile menu drawer trigger. Fixed bottom navigation bar (`fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-card/90 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-border flex justify-around items-center h-16 md:hidden`) with icon-driven quick links: Dashboard, Leads, Projects (Kanban), Invoices, and More Menu.
layout_and_navigation.header: Top bar header with non-transparent glassmorphism (`bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-border z-40 sticky top-0 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between`). Never use fully transparent backgrounds!

dashboard.kpi_card: p-5 rounded-xl bg-card border border-border/60 hover:border-accent/40 transition-all duration-200 shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden group
dashboard.sections: Main revenue & job completion chart (col-span-full md:col-span-8), Recent Activity feed & Urgent job site alerts (col-span-full md:col-span-4).

leads.header_actions: Search bar with Debounce + Filter dropdown (Status, Handyman Service Type, Date Range) + 'Nouveau Lead' primary CTA.
leads.detail_view: 2-column split view: Left sidebar with contact metadata & status stepper (Nouveau -> Visite -> Devis -> Accepté); Right panel with tabs (Overview, Line Items Calculator, Site Photos Gallery, Activity Notes).

invoices.creator_component: Modular card breakdown instead of monolithic 935-line file: Header metadata -> Client & Job selector -> Itemized pricing table with real-time tax calculator (TPS 5% + TVQ 9.975% Quebec rate) -> Payment method badges (Stripe, Interac e-Transfer, Wise) -> Action Footer (Draft, Save, Export PDF, Send Email, Copy Payment Link).
invoices.payment_links: Generates direct client portal URL with 1-click Stripe Checkout modal, Interac email instructions box with auto-copy answer/question, or Wise wire transfer details.

projects_kanban.board_layout: Horizontal scrollable grid `grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 overflow-x-auto pb-4`.
projects_kanban.card_style: p-4 rounded-xl bg-card border border-border shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing space-y-3
projects_kanban.card_metadata: Client name, site address badge, task progress bar (`w-full bg-muted h-2 rounded-full overflow-hidden`), assigned handyman avatar, and site photo thumbnail.

client_crm.summary_banner: High-impact card displaying Lifetime Value (LTV), total paid invoices, active renovation projects, and quick SMS/Email contact trigger.
client_crm.tabs: Projets Associés, Devis & Factures, Historique de Contact, Photos de Chantier.

micro_animations_and_interactions.status_pills: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold border transition-colors

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: Every button, input, link, tab, card, status badge, and invoice action MUST include a unique kebab-case data-testid attribute.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, avoid AI slop: build a tactile, artisan-grade Quebec renovation admin dashboard.
Never center-align main containers (.App { text-align: center }). Keep left aligned human reading flow.
Never use transparent backgrounds on headers, modals, or dropdown menus. Always use backdrop-blur + semi-opaque bg.
Add explicit hover text colors whenever changing background color (e.g. hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
Use data-testid on every single interactive element.
Ensure total responsiveness for contractors accessing on job-site mobile phones.
